query: SELECT id AS "id!" FROM (SELECT i.id,0 AS former FROM issues i JOIN team_keys t ON t.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND t.team_id=i.team_id WHERE i.workspace_id=$1 AND t.key=$2 AND i.number=$3 UNION ALL SELECT k.issue_id,1 FROM issue_key_aliases k JOIN team_keys t ON t.workspace_id=k.workspace_id AND t.team_id=k.team_id WHERE k.workspace_id=$1 AND t.key=$2 AND k.number=$3) found ORDER BY former LIMIT 1
